english.title: Possess for sale / agree sale / sell a package knowing it had failed the reference test
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[possessed for sale]_
(B)_[agreed to sell]_
(C)_[sold]_

a package of **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS OF PACKAGE..) in circumstances where you knew or had reasonable cause to believe that it came from a batch of packages which had failed the reference test
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(2) and 18(1) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possess for sale / agree sale / sell a package
knowing it had failed the reference test

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2 for definitions of 'package' and 'reference test'
(ii) Regulation 10(4) provides that proceedings for an offence under these Regulations, other than an offence under regulation 16, shall not be instituted after the expiration of the period of twelve months beginning with the date when the offence was committed.
